core_claim.P: When creating a campaign in DistributionCreator._createCampaign(), the minimum reward requirement is validated against the gross amount before fee deduction.
core_claim.I: The minimum reward threshold must be enforced against the net realAmount actually distributed after fees, so that effective reward rate does not fall below the intended minimum.
core_claim.V: Validation uses gross amount while net realAmount is stored/distributed, allowing campaigns whose effective reward rate falls below the intended minimum (e.g., 101 tokens/hour gross passing but delivering only 91 tokens/hour with a 10% fee).

distinct_impacts.description: Campaign creators can create campaigns that pass validation with gross amounts just above minimum but deliver rewards below minimum after fees.
distinct_impacts.evidence_quote: Campaign creators can create campaigns that pass validation with gross amounts just above minimum, but deliver rewards below minimum after fees.

distinct_impacts.description: The minimum reward threshold designed to prevent dust campaigns is undermined.
distinct_impacts.evidence_quote: This undermines the minimum reward threshold designed to prevent dust campaigns

distinct_impacts.description: Wasted gas for claimers results from dust campaigns.
Root cause mechanism: the check uses gross amount while net realAmount is what is actually distributed.
distinct_impacts.evidence_quote: The check at L544 uses `amount` (gross), but `realAmount` (net) is what's actually distributed.
